q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release would typically occur in late August/early September 2026 (based on their historical quarterly cadence). Today is 2026-08-18, so we're approximately **10-14 days** away from the earnings release and forward guidance announcement.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provides explicit forward guidance: **NVIDIA guided for Q2 FY2027 revenue of approximately $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** during their Q1 FY2027 earnings release on May 20, 2026.

This means the guidance range is approximately $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion (91.0 ± 2%).

Since this guidance was already publicly provided in May 2026 for the Q2 that we're now at the threshold of, the "forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release" is essentially already known. When companies report Q2 earnings, they typically either:
1. Reiterate their previous guidance if conditions haven't materially changed
2. Adjust guidance based on actual Q2 results and any changes to forward outlook

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will either:
- Reiterate the ~$91 billion guidance (if conditions have remained consistent)
- Adjust upward or downward slightly based on actual business performance

Given that:
- Q1 FY2027 delivered $81.6 billion (85% YoY growth)
- The $91 billion Q2 guidance represents ~12% sequential growth
- NVIDIA has been meeting/beating guidance consistently
- No major negative catalysts mentioned in the research

The most probable point estimate is around **$91 billion**, with potential for upward revision given NVIDIA's track record.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Unexpected weakness in data center demand post-Q1
- Geopolitical developments tightening China restrictions beyond current "no China data center revenue" assumption
- Supply chain disruptions affecting production
- Macro economic slowdown reducing enterprise AI capex
- Weaker-than-expected hyperscaler demand signals in mid-2026
- Revised guidance downward at earnings if Q2 tracking weaker than May expectations

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected bookings and demand through Q2
- Upward revision based on actual Q2 results beating the $91 billion guidance
- Expansion in markets beyond data center (automotive, enterprise software acceleration)
- Better-than-expected AI adoption driving hyperscaler capex acceleration
- Potential positive catalysts in China policy or new product announcements
- NVIDIA's historical tendency to guide conservatively and beat

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research explicitly states: "NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is expected to be approximately **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**" from their May 20, 2026 earnings release.

This is the only reliable base rate available — NVIDIA's own prior guidance for this specific quarter.

---

## Reasoning

The question asks for "what will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release." This is asking for a forward-looking statement WITHIN the Q2 earnings report (typically guidance for Q3). However, the research indicates what they already guided FOR Q2 in May.

Given the timing (we're 10-14 days from Q2 earnings), and the research showing their May guidance was $91.0B ±2%, the most likely scenario is:

1. They report Q2 actual results (likely close to or above $91B guidance)
2. They provide forward guidance for Q3 FY2027

If the question is interpreted as "what revenue did they guide FOR when discussing Q2" (backward-looking to prior guidance), it's $91.0B ±2%.

If it's asking "what will they guide FOR in the Q2 earnings call" (forward guidance for Q3), this requires extrapolation:
- Q1: $81.6B
- Q2 guidance: $91.0B (~12% sequential)
- Q3 guidance (TBD): Could be $100-105B range if momentum continues (10-15% sequential growth)

The range given (99.5 to 115.5B) suggests the question is asking for the forward guidance BEYOND Q2 (likely Q3 or beyond), not the Q2 guidance that already exists.

For forward guidance in the Q2 earnings release (which would be Q3 guidance or beyond):
- Base case would be ~$100-105B assuming continued momentum
- Upper case: $110-115B if acceleration continues
- Lower case: $95-100B if some moderation

Given the strong momentum, NVIDIA's track record, and the range provided suggesting this is asking for higher numbers, I'll estimate the most likely forward guidance to be in the **$101-105B range** for the next quarter, with distribution skewed toward the upper end.

Low (10th percentile): 95000000000
Median (50th percentile): 103000000000
High (90th percentile): 112000000000
q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is expected to be approximately **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**. This outlook was provided by NVIDIA on May 20, 2026, during their Q1 FY2027 earnings release [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027). This guidance is above the average analyst estimate of $86.84 billion [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html) but slightly below the consensus revenue of $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). NVIDIA explicitly stated that this outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). The company reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/).
